# ali-nuxt-toolkit

> Five independently-installable, type-driven packages for Vue 3 and Nuxt 3+: a typed `fetch` client, Web-Crypto encryption, layout-based route middleware, a headless international tel input, and measured skeleton loaders. Each package ships a framework-agnostic `./core` entry (Node / Bun / Deno / tests) alongside its Nuxt module or Vue component.

Packages live under the `@alikhalilll` scope and have zero runtime dependency on one another. Install one, three, or all five. Documentation is maintained alongside the code in `apps/docs/` (Nuxt Content, GitHub Pages) and every page is also served at a parallel `<route>.md` URL for machine consumption.

Design principles enforced across the repo: types-first public API, pure-function core (side effects at the smallest possible boundary), strategy-pattern dispatch for runtime variants, SSR-safe (no `window` / `document` at module scope), honest `sideEffects` declarations for tree-shaking. See the repository `CLAUDE.md` for the full policy.

## Docs — packages

- [@alikhalilll/nuxt-api-provider](https://alikhalilll.github.io/ali-nuxt-toolkit/api-provider.md): typed `fetch` client — TanStack-Query-style caching (SWR, dedupe, GC), interceptors, retry + exponential backoff, request timeouts, upload + download progress via transparent `XMLHttpRequest` fallback, structured `ApiError` with cross-realm `isApiError()` guard
- [@alikhalilll/nuxt-crypto](https://alikhalilll.github.io/ali-nuxt-toolkit/crypto.md): AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2-SHA256 on native Web Crypto — derived-key caching, pluggable algorithms, server-only mode, optional device-fingerprint binding (HttpOnly device-ID cookie survives network changes)
- [@alikhalilll/nuxt-auto-middleware](https://alikhalilll.github.io/ali-nuxt-toolkit/auto-middleware.md): declarative layout-based route middleware — glob + `RegExp` patterns, named groups, per-page overrides via `definePageMeta`, typed registry (typos are compile errors)
- [@alikhalilll/a-tel-input](https://alikhalilll.github.io/ali-nuxt-toolkit/ui/tel-input.md): headless international telephone input — smart country detection (IP / timezone / locale chain), `libphonenumber-js` validation, responsive popover + bottom-sheet drawer, first-class VeeValidate + Zod integration with async server-side checks
- [@alikhalilll/a-smart-skeleton](https://alikhalilll.github.io/ali-nuxt-toolkit/ui/smart-skeleton.md): measured skeleton loaders — renders real content invisibly, captures geometry (background, border, radius, box-shadow, text lines, media boxes), replays a pixel-faithful placeholder; zero cumulative layout shift; `smart` / `sequence` / `sweep` / `together` reveal strategies

## Per-package READMEs (deep reference)

- [a-tel-input README](https://github.com/alikhalilll/ali-nuxt-toolkit/blob/master/packages/ui-components/ATelInput/README.md): full prop / event / slot / exposed-method tables, VeeValidate + Zod recipes, theming tokens, accessibility notes
- [a-smart-skeleton README](https://github.com/alikhalilll/ali-nuxt-toolkit/blob/master/packages/ui-components/ASmartSkeleton/README.md): states, hints (`ask-block` / `ask-ignore` / `ask-own`), reveal strategies, chrome capture, theming
- [api-provider source](https://github.com/alikhalilll/ali-nuxt-toolkit/tree/master/packages/api-provider/src): source layout for cache, interceptors, retry, progress
- [crypto source](https://github.com/alikhalilll/ali-nuxt-toolkit/tree/master/packages/crypto/src): source layout for AES-GCM + PBKDF2, key cache, fingerprint binding
- [auto-middleware source](https://github.com/alikhalilll/ali-nuxt-toolkit/tree/master/packages/auto-middleware/src): source layout for the virtual registry and matcher
